name: Axiron
subtitle: Axiron Brand Identity & Visual Design
sourceHtml:
THE PROJECT

View on Fiverr ↗ (opens new tab)View matching Dribbble presentation ↗ (opens new tab)
overviewHtml:
Behind the identity

Axiron was a branding project focused on creating a modern, professional, and technology-driven visual identity. The goal was to develop a strong brand presence that communicates innovation, reliability, and precision across both digital and physical applications.

I created a cohesive brand identity starting with the Axiron logo, using a bold geometric symbol and a blue-and-white color palette to establish a distinctive and memorable look. I then extended the identity across multiple brand touchpoints, including website UI, business cards, presentation materials, social media graphics, marketing collateral, signage, and promotional designs.

The main challenge was maintaining consistency across very different formats while keeping the brand visually strong and recognizable. I addressed this by developing a unified visual system with consistent typography, colors, spacing, graphic elements, and layout principles.

The final result is a clean, modern, and versatile brand identity that gives Axiron a professional presence across both online and offline platforms.
